scope: Record actual browser efficiency qualification, same ordered coverage, independent reviews, unchanged accounting and exact Preview identity.
riskAnalysis: Documentation only. No runtime, configuration, permission, financial or historical evidence mutation.

threatModel.assets: Browser evidence correctness, exact source qualification and existing security boundaries.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Work-authored trusted QA code observes the protected Preview DOM; no generated code or permissions are added.
threatModel.abuseCases: Premature screenshot, wrong view, hidden or mid-transition sidebar, never-ending decorative animation, swallowed timeout or missing authentication/data assertion.
threatModel.mitigations: Self-contained state predicate, unique visible view, nav/aria-current, finite root transitions, fonts/busy and stable geometry. Native hard deadline propagates and original auth/data/diagnostics remain.

rollback: Revert only readiness helper, import and three navigation wait substitutions on the feature branch. Preserve all historical artifacts and qualification evidence.

negativePaths.malformed-response: Missing DOM state fails readiness; original API/data validation retained.
negativePaths.stale-state: Wrong view/nav or renewed loading during three frames rejects readiness.
negativePaths.concurrency: Geometry or busy changes during sampling reject readiness. No authority concurrency changes.
negativePaths.cancellation: Native Playwright wait deadline/rejection propagates; suite cleanup unchanged.
negativePaths.worker-interruption: Stalled page remains bounded by native wait timeout; existing suite finally closes contexts.
negativePaths.api-outage: Original network/data/API diagnostics unchanged; readiness does not assert freshness.
negativePaths.authorization-denial: Original authenticated-page and API denial checks unchanged.
negativePaths.spending-limit: No provider model/count or infrastructure dispatch introduced.
negativePaths.partial-execution: Suite cannot become successful through a swallowed readiness failure; all screenshot/report requirements retained.

defects.rootCause: Fixed pauses always delay ready pages and do not prove delayed state is ready.
defects.detectionGap: Elapsed wall-clock sleep was used as navigation synchronization.
defects.regression: Ready/delayed/multiple/wrong views, loading fonts/busy, finite paused and infinite animations, mobile sidebar/backdrop, layout movement, serialization and deadline propagation.
defects.historicalPrevention: Wait for the observed state while preserving all data/authentication/security and visual assertions.

proactiveReview.architecture: One small Browser QA helper within existing suite; no service or orchestration.
proactiveReview.dependencies: Existing Playwright only; no packages, credentials or infrastructure.
proactiveReview.threats: Incorrect readiness can invalidate UI evidence; cannot grant source execution or paid authority.
proactiveReview.failureModes: Unready DOM returns false; missing state and hard deadline fail qualification. Existing asynchronous data assertions remain necessary.
proactiveReview.faultInjection: Wrong/multiple panels, stalled loading/fonts, paused finite transition, endless decoration, moving layout, missing backdrop, incorrect mobile state and native timeout.
proactiveReview.independentChallenge: Separate Work QA and Auditor reviewed and tested code. No material finding; full hosted qualification remains mandatory.
proactiveReview.recovery: Revert the small helper and three replacements; preserve original failures and reports. No automatic provider retry.
proactiveReview.readiness: Actual qualified application remains1c666af; this checkpoint grants no execution authority.
